identity.name: Promaster Diver
identity.one_liner: The 2019 Citizen Promaster Diver with the 8204 caliber — the affordable automatic dive watch that competes with the Seiko SKX and the Orient Kamasu at the under-$600 price point.

narrative.story: The NY0150-58E is the 2019 Citizen Promaster Diver, the 44mm stainless steel automatic dive watch with the 8204 caliber (Citizen's entry automatic, hand-wind, hacking, 42-hour reserve). The 200m water resistance, the aluminum unidirectional bezel, and the day-date display are the 2019 specification. The Promaster is the most-cited modern Citizen dive watch and the watch a collector cites when they want a Japanese automatic dive watch at the under-$600 price point.
narrative.collector_notes: The 8204 caliber is Citizen's entry automatic (no hand-wind, no hacking — wait, the 8204 is hand-wind, hacking). The Promaster line was launched in 1989 for Citizen's professional sports watches.
